title: "02_mouse_annotate"
format: html

```{r}
source('../library.R')
source('../source.R')
mouse = readRDS('data/01_processed_data/01_mouse_processed.rds')
```

# Within-species reference-based annotation

Reference: <https://figshare.com/articles/dataset/Robject_files_for_tissues_processed_by_Seurat/5821263>

```{r}
load('data/02_annotation_refs/droplet_Mammary_Gland_seurat_tiss.Robj')
```

```{r}
mouse_ref = tiss |> UpdateSeuratObject()
mouse_ref = mouse_ref |> 
  subset(nCount_RNA > 0)
shared_genes = intersect(rownames(mouse),
                         rownames(mouse_ref))
mouse_ref = mouse_ref[shared_genes,]
mouse_annot = mouse[shared_genes,]

mouse_ref$celltype = case_when(
  mouse_ref$cell_ontology_class %in% c('luminal epithelial cell of mammary gland',
                                       'basal cell')~ 'Normal Epithelial',
  mouse_ref$cell_ontology_class == 'B cell' ~ 'B-cells',
  mouse_ref$cell_ontology_class == 'T cell' ~ 'T-cells',
  mouse_ref$cell_ontology_class == 'endothelial cell' ~ 'Endothelial',
  mouse_ref$cell_ontology_class == 'stromal cell' ~ 'Fibroblast',
  mouse_ref$cell_ontology_class == 'macrophage' ~ 'Myeloid'
) |> as.factor()
SaveSeuratRds(mouse_ref, 'data/02_annotation_refs/02_mouse_ref.rds')
as.anndata(mouse_ref, 
          file_path = 'data/02_annotation_refs/',
          file_name = '02_mouse_ref.h5ad',
          assay = 'RNA', main_layer = 'counts', 
          other_layers = c('data', 'scale.data'))
```

## Seurats

```{r}
# LabelTransfer rebuilds both objects from raw counts; the normalised layer is for SingleR below
mouse_annot = mouse_annot |>
  NormalizeData()

mouse_seurat_label = LabelTransfer(data = mouse_annot, ref = mouse_ref,
                                   celltype_column = 'celltype')
mouse$celltype_seurat = mouse_seurat_label$cell_type_transfer |> as.factor()
mouse$labelscore_seurat = mouse_seurat_label$score_transfer

mouse = mouse |> 
  NormalizeData() |> 
  ScaleData() |> 
  RunPCA(features = rownames(mouse)) |> 
  RunUMAP(dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE) |> 
  FindNeighbors(reduction = 'pca', dims = 1:20)
SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
```

```{r}
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = 'celltype_seurat')
ggplot(mouse@meta.data, aes(x = labelscore_seurat)) +
  geom_histogram()
ggplot(mouse@meta.data, aes(x = celltype_seurat, y = labelscore_seurat)) +
  geom_boxplot()
DimPlot(mouse, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'celltype_seurat',
        shuffle = TRUE)
```

## SingleR

```{r}
mouse_singleR_label = LabelSingleR(data = mouse_annot, ref = mouse_ref, 
                                   celltype_column = 'celltype',
                                   tech = 'MERFISH') 
mouse$celltype_singleR = mouse_singleR_label$cell_type_singleR
mouse$labeldelta_singleR = mouse_singleR_label$delta_singleR
SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
```

```{r}
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
ImageDimPlot(mouse, group.by = 'celltype_singleR')
ggplot(mouse@meta.data, aes(x = labeldelta_singleR)) +
  geom_histogram()
ggplot(mouse@meta.data, aes(x = celltype_singleR, y = labeldelta_singleR)) +

DimPlot(mouse, reduction = 'umap', group.by = 'celltype_singleR',
        shuffle = TRUE)
```

## Compare

```{r}
markers_mm = list(
  Luminal     = c("Epcam", "Cdh1", "Krt8", "Krt18", "Krt19"),
  Basal       = c("Krt5", "Krt14", "Trp63", "Acta2"),
  Fibroblast  = c("Pdgfra", "Col1a1", "Col3a1", "Dcn", "Lum"),
  Endothelial = c("Pecam1", "Cdh5", "Cldn5", "Kdr", "Emcn"),
  T_cells     = c("Ptprc", "Cd3e", "Cd3d", "Cd2", "Cd8a"),
  B_cells     = c("Cd19", "Ms4a1", "Cd79a", "Cd79b", "Pax5"),
  Myeloid     = c("Cd68", "Adgre1", "Csf1r", "Lyz2", "C1qa")
)

missing = setdiff(unlist(markers_mm), rownames(mouse))
missing   # genes not on the panel

markers_mm = lapply(markers_mm, intersect, rownames(mouse))
markers_mm = markers_mm[lengths(markers_mm) > 0]

DotPlot(mouse, features = markers_mm, group.by = "celltype_seurat") +
  RotatedAxis()
DotPlot(mouse |> subset(!is.na(celltype_singleR)), features = markers_mm, group.by = "celltype_singleR") +
  RotatedAxis()

ggplot(subset(mouse, subset = is.na(mouse$celltype_singleR))@meta.data,
       aes(x = labelscore_seurat)) +
  geom_histogram()

mouse$celltype_seurat |> table(mouse$celltype_singleR) |> prop.table() |> heatmap(scale = 'row', symm = TRUE)
```

```{r}
mouse$celltype_singleR_filled = coalesce(mouse$celltype_singleR, mouse$celltype_seurat)
```

# Cross-species reference-based annotation

Reference: <https://www.garvan.org.au/research/collaboration/the-breast-cancer-cell-atlas>

```{r}
mouse_ref = readRDS('data/02_annotation_refs/02_human_ref.rds')

mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data$gene_name = rownames(mouse)

homology_tbl = read.csv('../homology_tbl.csv')

mouse_gene_dict = homology_tbl |> 
  filter(!is.na(mmusculus_homolog_orthology_type)) |> 
  dplyr::select(mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene,
                mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name) |> 
  filter(!is.na(mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name)) |> 
  filter(!mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name == '') |> 
  unique()

mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data = left_join(
  mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data, mouse_gene_dict, 
  join_by(gene_name == mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name)
)

# panel genes missing from the homology table, matched by symbol
mouse_na_ensembl_id = c(Cbx3     = 'ENSMUSG00000029836',
                        `H2-Aa`  = 'ENSMUSG00000036594',
                        Cldn4    = 'ENSMUSG00000047501',
                        Cxcl11   = 'ENSMUSG00000060183',
                        Trdv4    = 'ENSMUSG00000076867',
                        Ccl1     = 'ENSMUSG00000020702',
                        Wap      = 'ENSMUSG00000000381',
                        `H2-K1`  = 'ENSMUSG00000061232',
                        `H2-T10` = 'ENSMUSG00000079491',
                        `H2-Q6`  = 'ENSMUSG00000073409',
                        `H2-Eb1` = 'ENSMUSG00000060586')

mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data$ensembl_id = coalesce(
  mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data$mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene,
  unname(mouse_na_ensembl_id[mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data$gene_name])
)

rownames(mouse) = mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data$ensembl_id

mouse_gene_dict = homology_tbl |> 
  arrange(mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene) |> 
  dplyr::select(ensembl_gene_id, external_gene_name) |> 
  filter(!is.na(external_gene_name)) |> 
  filter(!external_gene_name == '') |> 
  unique()

mouse_ref[['RNA']]@meta.data$gene_name = rownames(mouse_ref)

mouse_ref[['RNA']]@meta.data = left_join(
  mouse_ref[['RNA']]@meta.data, mouse_gene_dict, 
  join_by(gene_name == external_gene_name), multiple = 'first'
)

# genes without an Ensembl match keep their symbol (unique), rather than all sharing one ID
mouse_ref[['RNA']]@meta.data$ensembl_gene_id = coalesce(mouse_ref[['RNA']]@meta.data$ensembl_gene_id, mouse_ref[['RNA']]@meta.data$gene_name)

rownames(mouse_ref) = mouse_ref@assays$RNA@meta.data$ensembl_gene_id

mouse_ref_mouse = concatenate(mouse_ref, mouse, homology_tbl, tech_human = 'RNA', tech_mouse = 'MERFISH')

rownames(mouse_ref_mouse) = mouse_ref_mouse@assays$MERFISH@meta.data$gene_name

DefaultAssay(mouse_ref_mouse) = 'RNA'
DefaultLayer(mouse_ref_mouse[['RNA']]) = 'data'
mouse_ref_mouse = mouse_ref_mouse |> 
  subset(orig.ident == 'hsapiens')

mouse_ref_mouse$nCount_RNA = colSums(x = mouse_ref_mouse[['RNA']]$counts)
mouse_ref_mouse = mouse_ref_mouse |> 
  subset(nCount_RNA > 0)

SaveSeuratRds(mouse_ref_mouse, 'data/02_annotation_refs/human_processed_mouse_use.rds')
```

```{r}
print('EBCC')
mouse = readRDS('data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')

mouse$celltype_seurat = mouse$celltype_seurat |>
    recode('Fibroblast' = 'CAFs')

mouse$celltype_singleR = mouse$celltype_singleR |>
    recode('Fibroblast' = 'CAFs')

ann_cols = c("celltype_seurat", "celltype_singleR", 'celltype_seurat_cross', 'celltype_singleR_cross')
# every label any annotator gives (run_ebcc needs the prior to cover all of them)
classes_all = lapply(ann_cols, function(a) as.character(mouse@meta.data[[a]])) |>
  unlist() |> na.omit() |> unique()
# hide one random annotator's label for 10% of cells
set.seed(1)
meta_ho = mouse@meta.data
ho = data.frame(cell = sample(nrow(meta_ho), round(0.1 * nrow(meta_ho))))
ho$ann   = sample(ann_cols, nrow(ho), replace = TRUE)
ho$truth = mapply(function(i, a) as.character(meta_ho[[a]][i]), ho$cell, ho$ann)
for (a in ann_cols) {
  meta_ho[[a]] = as.character(meta_ho[[a]])
  meta_ho[[a]][ho$cell[ho$ann == a]] = NA
}

for (a in ann_cols) {
  print(save_dotplot(mouse, markers_pymt, a, paste0('mouse_dotplot_', sub('celltype_', '', a), '.png'), dir = '../figures/breast_cancer/annotation'))
}
               
trusted = list(
celltype_seurat = c('Endothelial', 'Myeloid'),
celltype_singleR  = c('Endothelial', 'CAFs', 'Myeloid'),
celltype_seurat_cross = c('PVL', 'Normal Epithelial', 'Myeloid', 'CAFs', 'Cancer Epithelial'),
celltype_singleR_cross = c('PVL', 'T-cells', 'Endothelial', 'Cancer Epithelial', 'CAFs')
)
n_k = list(
  celltype_seurat = table(mouse$celltype_seurat),
  celltype_singleR = table(mouse$celltype_singleR),
  celltype_seurat_cross = table(mouse$celltype_seurat_cross),
  celltype_singleR_cross = table(mouse$celltype_singleR_cross)
)

# default priors, strengthened on the diagonal for each annotator's trusted classes
# (trusted classes the annotator never called are skipped)
make_trusted_beta = function(M, frac) {
  beta = make_beta_prior(classes_all, ann_cols)
  for (a in names(trusted)) for (k in trusted[[a]]) {
    n = if (k %in% names(n_k[[a]])) n_k[[a]][[k]] else 0
    if (n > 0) beta[[a]][k, k] = 4 + frac * n / M
  }
  beta
}

# fit with M subtypes, then score how well the hidden labels are predicted
heldout_ll = function(M, frac, R = 3) {
  f = run_ebcc(meta_ho, ann_cols, M = M, R = R, keep_rho = TRUE, beta = make_trusted_beta(M, frac))
  lp = unlist(lapply(ann_cols, function(a) {
    s = ho[ho$ann == a, ]
    l = match(s$truth, f$classes); ok = !is.na(l)
    # P(hidden label) = sum over class-subtypes of P(cell in it) x P(annotator gives that label)
    log(rowSums(f$rho[s$cell[ok], , drop = FALSE] *
                t(f$par$v[[a]][, l[ok], drop = FALSE])))
  }))
  lp
}

# ---- joint (M, frac) held-out grid ----
# M in 1, 2, 3, 5, 10 x frac in 0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2; 3 restarts per fit; one process per frac.
# Rule: best mean held-out log-likelihood; among (M, frac) within 1 SE of it, smallest M then smallest frac.
source('ebcc_grid.R')
grid = heldout_grid(heldout_ll, Ms = c(1, 2, 3, 5, 10), fracs = c(0, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2), threads = 4)
grid_changed = save_heldout_grid(grid, 'mouse', previous_M = 2, previous_frac = 0, ho = ho)
grid$grid
c(M = grid$M, frac = grid$frac, changed = grid_changed)

# ---- fit ----
# M: 1-SE rule on the frac = 0 column of the held-out grid (data/02_annotated_data/mouse_ebcc_heldout_grid.csv)
# frac: best mean marker AUROC on the selection half, M fixed (data/02_annotated_data/mouse_ebcc_frac_auroc_chosen.csv;
#   pipeline/02_mouse_ebcc_frac_select.R). frac was tuned for marker agreement (../EBCC_PIPELINE.md section 3b).
M = 2
frac = 0
fit = run_ebcc(mouse@meta.data, ann_cols, M = M, R = 10, beta = make_trusted_beta(M, frac))

# ---- diagnostics ----
# 1. restarts: distance of each restart's ELBO from the best (large spread = many local optima)
round(fit$elbo_restarts - max(fit$elbo_restarts), 1)

# ---- save ----
mouse$ebcc_label   = fit$label
mouse$ebcc_maxpost = rowMaxs(fit$posterior)
mouse$ebcc_entropy = -rowSums(fit$posterior * log(fit$posterior + 1e-12))
mouse$celltype     = mouse$ebcc_label
save_dotplot(mouse, markers_pymt, 'ebcc_label', 'mouse_dotplot_ebcc.png', dir = '../figures/breast_cancer/annotation')

# gene symbols + Ensembl IDs, used by 03_concatenate to map orthologs
homology_tbl = read.csv('../homology_tbl.csv')
mouse_gene_dict = homology_tbl |>
  filter(!is.na(mmusculus_homolog_orthology_type) &
           !mmusculus_homolog_orthology_type == '') |>
  dplyr::select(mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene,
                mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name) |>
  filter(!is.na(mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name) &
           !mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name == '' &
           !is.na(mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene) &
           !mmusculus_homolog_ensembl_gene == '') |>
  unique()
mouse[['MERFISH']]@meta.data = data.frame(gene_name = rownames(mouse)) |>
  left_join(mouse_gene_dict,
            join_by(gene_name == mmusculus_homolog_associated_gene_name))

saveRDS(fit$par,      'data/02_annotated_data/mouse_ebcc_params.rds')
saveRDS(fit$posterior, 'data/02_annotated_data/mouse_ebcc_posterior.rds')
SaveSeuratRds(mouse, 'data/02_annotated_data/02_mouse_annotated.rds')
as.anndata(mouse, file_path = 'data/02_annotated_data/',
           file_name = '02_mouse_annotated.h5ad', assay = 'MERFISH',
           main_layer = 'counts', other_layers = c('data'))
```
